brief:
The Israeli military said it will not remove settlers who have occupied eight Palestinian homes in a Jericho neighbourhood, Middle East Eye reported. The takeover occurred earlier this month when Israeli families raided the West Bank area and seized the residences.

The decision marks a continuation of settlement expansion in occupied Palestinian territory, where Israeli authorities have faced repeated international criticism over such actions.

title: Israeli military refuses to evict settlers from Palestinian homes in Jericho
